text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa... haa...! Just... one more 
step—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!? She's accelerating here...! 
Ramonu-san...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahaha! Ah... How wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu wins the Oaks...! With this, 
she claims the second crown!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just one more win... until the first 
Triple Tiara in history!!
(Mur... mur...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
S-She really... won. Mejiro Ramonu... What 
incredible strength.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...That effortless demeanor. That 
perfection... She is unlike any girl who 
has competed on the Tiara route until 
now..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Unbelievably, overwhelmingly strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's her. It has to be... Lady Ramonu is 
the only one. The first in history—the 
Triple Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The final crown already rests upon this 
head of mine."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to paint that shape 
with my running...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho—a sublime race. And that 
victory... I shall dedicate to my 
beloved."
(Clap clap clap...!)

Her running is polished further and 
further even amidst fierce races. It feels 
as though her legs will stretch out 
infinitely without end.

For the racing I love so much... and more 
than that, right now, a desire to keep 
witnessing Mejiro Ramonu's love... her 
running, is awakening inside me.
choice_data_list_en: (I want to see more of her "love".)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: 素晴らしい走りだった！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A flushed face. Isn't it a bit too early 
for summer?

"Summer... Speaking of which, Tracen 
Academy holds a summer training camp to 
improve the Umamusume's skills, and Mejiro 
Ramonu will also be participating."
choice_data_list:
This summer, let's sharpen your running 
even more

This summer, let's sharpen your running 
even more

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: 夏は君の走りを、もっと研ぎ澄まそう
夏は貴方の走りを、もっと研ぎ澄まそう
choice_data_list_en: Let's sharpen your running even more this summer.
Let's sharpen your running even more this summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Stepping away from the turf is lonely, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If I polish myself while we're apart... 
our love will only grow deeper."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Let us nurture it. Deep within this 
heart... slowly and carefully.

And so, to ensure victory in the final 
jewel of the Triple Crown, the "Shuka 
Sho"... The days of training begin once 
again.
